title: erophila verna var. claviformis
intro: Erophila verna var. claviformis, commonly known as Rock Cress, is a flowering plant species. It is traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal effects. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as soothing skin irritations, wound healing, and reducing fever. Bioactive constituents of Rock Cress include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
